title: Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAseq Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the sixth part of a ten part protocol for the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Kit](https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/instruments-and-automation/genereader-system/generead-qiaact-lung-panels-ww/?catno=181936) which constructs molecularly bar-coded DNA libraries for digital sequencing. This protocol automates the Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAseq Beads part described in the [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI Panel Handbook](https://www.qiagen.com/us/resources/download.aspx?id=1a71d98a-c45c-44fa-b4af-874cd1d2b61f&lang=en). * Part 1: [GeneRead QIAact Lung RNA Fusion UMI](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210) * Part 2: [Reverse transcription](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-2) * Part 3: [Second strand synthesis](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-3) * Part 4: [End repair / dA tailing](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-4) * Part 5: [Adaptor ligation](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-5) * Part 6: [Cleanup of Adapter-ligated DNA with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-6) * Part 7: [Target Enrichment PCR](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-7) * Part 8: [Cleanup of Target Enrichment PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-8) * Part 9: [Universal PCR Amplification](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-9) * Part 10: [Cleanup of Universal PCR with QIAseq Beads](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/111210-part-10) Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Samples`: The total number of DNA samples. Samples must range between 1 (minimum) and 12 (maximum). * `P20 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. * `P300 Single GEN2 Pipette Mount Position`: The position of the pipette, either left or right. * `Magnetic Module Engage Height`: The height the magnets should raise. ---

steps.title: Transfer ligation product
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of ligation product into a deep‑well plate positioned on the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add beads and bind
steps.instruction: Add 90 µL of QIAseq beads to the ligation mixture, mix gently, incubate 5 min at room temperature, then engage the magnetic module for 10 min to bind the beads.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant, then aspirate any residual liquid from the well.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (first cleanup)
steps.instruction: Perform two ethanol washes followed by a brief centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 260 µL of 70 % ethanol to each well and remove the ethanol.
Repeat the addition and removal of 260 µL ethanol.

steps.title: Final bead drying (first cleanup)
steps.instruction: Place the plate back on the magnetic module, engage for 2 min, remove any remaining supernatant, and air‑dry the beads for 10 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA (first cleanup)
steps.instruction: Add 52 µL of nuclease‑free water to the dried beads, engage the magnetic module for 5 min, then transfer 50 µL of the eluate to a new deep‑well plate located in Slot 4.

steps.title: Add QIAseq beads (second cleanup)
steps.instruction: Add 65 µL of QIAseq beads to the new plate, mix by pipetting 10 times with 50 µL volume, and incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind beads (second cleanup)
steps.instruction: Remove the original deep‑well plate, place the new plate on the magnetic module, and engage the magnets for 10 min.

steps.title: Discard supernatant (second cleanup)
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and any residual liquid from the wells.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (second cleanup)
steps.instruction: Perform two ethanol washes followed by a brief centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 70 % ethanol to each well and remove the ethanol.
Repeat the addition and removal of 200 µL ethanol.

steps.title: Final bead drying (second cleanup)
steps.instruction: Return the plate to the magnetic module, engage for 2 min, completely remove supernatant, and air‑dry the beads for 10 min.

steps.title: Final elution
steps.instruction: Add 22 µL of nuclease‑free water to elute DNA, engage the magnet for 10 min, then transfer 9.4 µL of the eluate into two PCR tubes placed in Slot 2.
